_meta.author: driver (Phase 1)
_meta.purpose: Facts the DRIVER verified first-hand by reading source and by a read-only production probe. These outrank a candidate's assertion: where a candidate disagrees with one of these, the candidate is wrong unless it cites better evidence. Fed to the reconcile as ground truth.

verified.fact: The insertion point is unambiguous: 'missed-opportunities' goes BETWEEN 'recovery-counts' and 'recovery-leader'.
verified.evidence: CompanyMetricsOverview::cards() currently holds exactly 7 entries in this order: scan-count, recovery-counts, recovery-leader, live-hits, historical-hits, staging-live-hits, staging-historical-hits. The docblock's 4x4 mockup grid puts Missed Opportunities at row 3 col 3 and LPR Recovery Leaderboard (recovery-leader) at row 3 col 4, so the new key immediately precedes recovery-leader.

verified.fact: The array is explicitly NOT append-only, and the docblock says so in shouting caps: '==> THOSE 9 GAPS ARE LOAD-BEARING. THIS ARRAY IS NOT APPEND-ONLY. <=='. It also warns not to reorder it to make a diff look smaller.
verified.evidence: The Company Metrics foundation deliberately paid the reorder cost once so nine sibling tickets each drop in without repeating it.
verified.implication: Appending the card to the end of the array would satisfy a naive reading of 'add a card' and still be wrong.

verified.fact: THREE assertions break in tests/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/Concerns/DashboardCardVisibilityTest.php -- a file the TICKET NEVER MENTIONS -- and one of them is a tripwire the foundation PR left deliberately for this ticket.
verified.evidence: (a) :44-64 test_every_real_card_is_ungated_and_therefore_expandable() loops every card asserting canViewCardData() is true, with the comment 'the Company Metrics foundation builds the seam but gates nothing. If this ever fails, a card was gated without the ticket that did it updating this expectation.' -- this card is the FIRST real gated card, so it trips by design. (b) :144 assertCount(7, CompanyMetricsOverview::cards()) must become 8. (c) :57-62 assertSame(cards(), expandableCards()) 'with nothing gated, expandableCards() must equal cards()' -- no longer true once a real gate exists for a non-Pro viewer.
verified.confirms: fast-pass claim C6, and finds one more touch point than the fast pass listed

verified.fact: The guest path is real, load-bearing, and has bitten this code before. canViewCardData() MUST be guest-safe, and must return TRUE for a guest -- not false.
verified.evidence: (a) expandableCards() is array_filter(cards(), fn => $class::canViewCardData()); array_filter PRESERVES keys, so a card returning false is DROPPED from expandableCards(). (b) tests/.../DashboardCardVisibilityTest.php:335-348 test_can_view_card_data_is_total_with_no_authenticated_user() asserts, with NO actingAs, that array_keys(cards()) === array_keys(expandableCards()). A card gated false for a guest breaks that equality. (c) That same test records a prior regression in its comment: 'an earlier version of this default called static::canView() unguarded and errored with hasAnyRole() on null'. (d) The Pennant flag resolver is Feature::define(FeatureEnum::MISSED_OPPORTUNITY->slug(), fn (User $user) => ...) -- a NON-NULLABLE User parameter, so invoking it with a guest's null scope throws a TypeError.
verified.confirms: fast-pass claim C5 IN FULL, including its conclusion that the closed reference implementation's `auth()->check() && (...)` shape (which returns FALSE for a guest) is wrong against the CURRENT test contract
verified.significance: The ticket tells the implementer to read the reference implementation for approach. On this specific point the reference implementation would introduce a failing test. This is the single most important thing for the implementer to get right.

verified.fact: MISSED_OPPORTUNITY is a CLARITY_PRO tier feature. It is absent from BASIC and from PRO_LITE.
verified.evidence: ProTierEnum::CLARITY_PRO's feature list includes FeatureEnum::MISSED_OPPORTUNITY; PRO_LITE's does not; BASIC's is empty.
verified.implication: AC-5 ('Non-Pro orgs do not see the value') is well-defined: BASIC and PRO_LITE orgs get the locked card, CLARITY_PRO orgs get the value. InsightLPR staff bypass via isInsightLpr().

verified.fact: NOTHING in the test suite constrains getStatColor(). A missing arm really is a silent failure.
verified.evidence: git grep 'getStatColor' over tests/ returns zero matches. So the ticket's warning that the `default => 'gray'` arm 'fails silently' is accurate, and no existing test would catch the omission.
verified.implication: The new test file should pin the colour arm, since no existing test will.

verified.fact: The three card widgets that reference CompanyMetricsOverview (HotlistCount:63, KitUsers:47, RecoveryLeader:140) do so ONLY in docblock prose. None carries a hardcoded card count or index.
verified.evidence: Read each reference in context; all three are explanatory comments about where the key registry lives.
verified.implication: These backstop hits are NOT misses. No code change needed in them.

verified.fact: Production probe (read-only, ClickHouse Cloud): the grain error is 3.68x fleet-wide and 4.32x in the largest org; and FINAL provably does not change a distinct-hotlist count (delta exactly 0 at full scale).
verified.confirms: fast-pass claims C1 and C3, the latter by measurement rather than by argument

real_misses: tests/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/Concerns/DashboardCardVisibilityTest.php (already caught by the fast pass; see V3)
checked_and_dismissed: The 6 DashboardWidget subclasses (HistoricalHits, LiveHits, RecoveryCounts, ScanCount, StagingLiveHits, StagingHistoricalHits) - they merely extend the base class; adding a match arm to getStatColor() does not touch them
app/Filament/Pages/Dashboard.php:79 - hosts the widget, no per-card knowledge

The MISSED_OPPORTUNITY consumers (AlertSettingsForm, ActivityResource, MissedOpportunityResource, ListMissedOpportunities, LifetimeMissedOpportunitiesWidget, client MissedOpportunitiesWidget, MissedOpportunityNotification, MissedOpportunityPolicy) - all read the same flag but are untouched by adding a dashboard card; explicitly out of scope
app/Enums/FeatureEnum.php, app/Enums/ProTierEnum.php - read for V5, no change needed
scopeSelectTotal siblings (ClientHistoricalHits, HotlistStatusAggregate) - unrelated models sharing a scope name

app/Filament/Pages/Concerns/HasStatDrillDown.php, ClientAnalytics, IndividualClientAnalytics - client-panel consumers of the CLIENT MissedOpportunitiesWidget, a different widget from the dashboard card
Mail/, Actions/, FilamentServiceProvider - name-collision on the string 'MissedOpportunities', not the dashboard card
backstop_disposition.note: The backstop was capped at 40 entries and reported truncated:true; the excluded remainder was a DB seeder, a CSS comment, and okf/ docs. Given every one of the 40 resolved to either a known target file or a dismissable reference, the truncation is not material.
